# MetroCity credits

All art in this folder is the MetroCity pixel-art series by **JIK-A-4**, released under **CC0** (public domain; commercial use allowed, credit appreciated).

Original archives are kept untouched in `art-src/MetroCity/` at the repo root.

| Folder | Pack |
| --- | --- |
| `Cars/` | MetroCity (cars, ambulance, police car, fire truck) |
| `Characters/Model`, `Hair`, `Outfits` | MetroCity 3 (character model, layered hair, outfits) |
| `Characters/Suits`, `Characters/Hair/Pack20` | MetroCity 2.0 / 2.0 Ext |
| `Environment/Tiles`, `Trees`, `Buildings` | MetroCity (tiles, trees, buildings) |
| `Environment/Road` | MetroCity 2.0 Ext |
| `Environment/Stations` | MetroCity 2.1 (house, fire station, police station) |
